main.description: Form a new PoNF block (fruiting body) from accumulated nutrient flow. The block captures total_flow, participant_count, eta_min_used, and links to prev_block_id. Called by BPMN ponf-fruiting.bpmn when flow threshold is reached.

networkRootDid.description: Root DID of the kabi network triggering fruiting

prevBlockId.description: Previous block vertex_id (null for genesis block)

totalFlow.description: Accumulated nutrient flow since last block

etaMinUsed.description: Minimum η used as PoNF gate
